text:
Nina Patel: Hey folks 1 1 0 Updated mock for org settings: compact roles grid + new invite flow + SSO enforcement messaging + audit log paging. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc987/org-settings-v4. Can product/eng/a11y skim? Drop quick notes in the figma with tag UX-REVIEW pls.

Owen Brooks: Skimming. First pass: 5 columns at 1440 feels cramped. Suggest collapsing 'view logs' and 'export' into a More popover per role to reduce horizontal noise.

Nina Patel: Good call. Alternate: show most common perms inline, move rare perms to an expandable detail row. Keeps scanning fast.

Diego Alvarez: From eng: expand/collapse is fine but ensure keyboard focus order follows visual order. We should avoid detaching elements to a different container when expanded (affects screen readers).

Rina Gupta: Copy note on the invite modal: current heading "Invite teammates". Propose "Invite members & assign roles". Also add small helper copy under email input: "Multiple addresses allowed, separated by commas."

Victor Chen: For invite links: add expiry presets (1h, 24h, 7d) and checkbox "single-use link". Backend already supports expiry param, single-use will need a token rotation endpoint.

Nina Patel: OK, we'll mark single-use as later sprint. UX should show expiry in the confirmation toast, e.g. "Link created 024-03-05 14:32 UTC (expires in 24h)".

Owen Brooks: SSO toggle copy needs to be explicit. Right now it's "SSO (SAML)". Recommend two-line label: top line "Require SSO for sign-in" bottom line (muted) "Turning on will block password sign-in and may sign out non-SSO sessions." Add a confirmation step for admins.

Rina Gupta: +1 for confirmation. Also suggest the confirmation modal lists affected user groups and a checkbox "I understand" to prevent accidental flips.

Diego Alvarez: Dev caveat: if we force sign-out, we need a rolling grace window to avoid immediate mass session invalidation spikes. Will coordinate with infra.

A11y Bot: a11y checklist: use role="table" for roles grid, ensure each expand button has aria-controls and aria-expanded. For the invite modal, announce creation success with polite aria-live="polite". Provide visible focus ring on the confirmation modal primary button.

Nina Patel: Great. Also audit log behavior: current modal uses infinite scroll and folks say it's hard to find older events. Proposed change: switch to cursor-based paging with explicit "Load older" button and a sticky time-range filter at the top. Also add a direct "Jump to date" quick picker.

Owen Brooks: Cursor paging+Load older is straightforward. For jump-to-date we can add a server seek by timestamp; may need an index. Diego, can infra add an index on event_time?

Diego Alvarez: Yep, we'll add a secondary index on event_time. Seek endpoint will take a timestamp cursor and return surrounding results.

Rina Gupta: Accessibility nit: each audit row should be focusable and the action menu reachable via keyboard; currently menu opens on click only. Add key handler for Enter/Space to open the menu.

A11y Bot: Also ensure the timestamp column has aria-sort if sorting is supported. Provide skip link to jump to the filter pane.

Victor Chen: On batching: for the condensed roles grid we plan to allow multiple permission toggles before saving. We'll add a batch update endpoint: PATCH /orgs/:id/roles/:role_id/permissions with a list. UX should show unsaved indicator and a Save all button.

Nina Patel: UX proposal: small unsaved chip per role "Unsaved changes" and a global "Save changes" sticky at the bottom of the page. On save show snackbar "Permissions updated" with Undo (5s). If a role fails to save show inline error row.

Owen Brooks: logging/analytics: track events: `invite_initiated`, `invite_link_created`, `sso_toggled`, `permissions_batch_saved`. Include org_id, actor_id, and deltas. Add these to the spec.

Diego Alvarez: We'll stub event ingestion now. Provide event schema in the spec and we'll wire it up.

Rina Gupta: Small copy tweak for the Save button: prefer "Save changes to roles" over generic "Save" when in context.

Nina Patel: Nice. I'll update the Figma copy and attach a short spec doc with event names, API endpoints, and a11y checklist. Please review and add quick comments in the file by EOD tomorrow.

Victor Chen: I'll prep a tiny keyboard prototype to validate focus order and batch save flows.

A11y Bot: reminder: test with NVDA/VoiceOver and keyboard-only. Report any missing aria labels in the figma comments.

Nina Patel: Thanks everyone 1 If no objections by Wednesday morning I'll freeze the spec for sprint planning. Tag any blockers in the figma comments with label BLOCKER.

Owen Brooks: No blockers from infra side.

Diego Alvarez: No blockers but will need a 1-day infra change for the index.

Rina Gupta: No accessibility blockers; will run quick pass after updates.

Victor Chen: No objections from eng.

Nina Patel: Awesome 1 Closing loop soon. :sparkles:
